B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when a mixed number is only normalized from an improper fractional part without creating a common denominator.
Do not tag for simplification of the final answer.

skills.name: Normalize compound forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard equivalent quantity.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a quantity is converted to an improper fraction as the chosen setup for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator alone.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction once the forms are already prepared.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned quantities
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract whole and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible forms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for creating common denominators or rewriting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing one whole to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for reducing the final result to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part by borrowing from the whole part and express the final answer in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 whole and converts it to denominator-over-denominator units.
Tag when a zero fraction is simplified to a whole number or 0.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number is reduced to lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction finishes without any regrouping or simplification step shown.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of whole numbers or nonstandard mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag for common-denominator conversion by itself.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless a denominator-matching conversion is also carried out.
Do not tag for converting an entire mixed number to an improper fraction if no common-denominator step is involved.

skills.name: Represent quantities compatibly
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form such as a mixed number with 0 fractional part, a normalized mixed number, or an improper fraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when quantities are converted to improper fractions to carry out the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for common-denominator conversion alone.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction once the forms are already prepared.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and/or subtracting whole and fractional parts separately.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when subtraction is performed after conversion to improper fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or rewriting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing when the fractional part would be negative and/or reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including simplifying to a whole number or zero when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator for the fraction part.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a result like 0/3 is simplified to 0 or a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for ordinary subtraction that does not require regrouping and is not followed by simplification.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of quantities before subtraction.
Do not tag for common-denominator conversion by itself.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag normalization of a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part unless a common denominator is also being created.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts of mixed numbers.
Tag when a step subtracts fractional parts after denominators have been matched or were already equal.
Tag when a step subtracts after converting entire mixed numbers to improper fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a whole and fraction before re-subtracting.
Do not tag simplification-only or final formatting steps.

skills.name: Regroup or normalize
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into an equivalent form to make subtraction possible, such as normalizing a nonstandard mixed number, rewriting a whole as a mixed number with 0 fractional part, or borrowing 1 from the whole part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a nonstandard mixed number like 2 3/2 is normalized to a standard equivalent form.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d to align with a mixed-number or fraction subtraction setup.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into d/d (or added to the fractional part) because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between proper fractions.
Do not tag direct subtraction steps after the quantities are already in workable form.
Do not tag simplification of the final answer.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and present it in an acceptable final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number or integer final answer.
Tag when a step states the result is already in lowest terms as the final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag borrowing or normalization steps used before subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.
